mixed_precision.label: Mixed precision
mixed_precision.info: Use mixed precision for training. bf16 is generally recommended for FLUX/Z-Image on supported GPUs; fp16 may be less stable.

num_cpu_threads_per_process.label: Number of CPU threads per core
num_cpu_threads_per_process.info: CPU threads per process used by accelerate (data loading and preprocessing).

num_processes.label: Number of processes
num_processes.info: The total number of processes to be launched in parallel.

num_machines.label: Number of machines
num_machines.info: The total number of machines used in this training.

multi_gpu.label: Multi GPU
multi_gpu.info: Whether or not this should launch a distributed GPU training.

gpu_ids.label: GPU IDs
gpu_ids.info: Comma-separated GPU IDs to use on this machine (e.g., 0,1). Leave empty for auto.

main_process_port.label: Main process port
main_process_port.info: Port of the main process for multi-GPU runs (0 = accelerate's default 29500).

dynamo_backend.label: Dynamo backend
dynamo_backend.info: Backend for torch dynamo JIT. Use 'no' to disable (recommended for stability), or 'inductor' for PyTorch 2.x optimizations.

dynamo_mode.label: Dynamo mode
dynamo_mode.info: Choose a mode to optimize your training with dynamo. Leave empty for default.

dynamo_use_fullgraph.label: Dynamo use fullgraph
dynamo_use_fullgraph.info: Whether to use full graph mode for dynamo or it is ok to break model into several subgraphs

dynamo_use_dynamic.label: Dynamo use dynamic
dynamo_use_dynamic.info: Whether to enable dynamic shape tracing.

extra_accelerate_launch_args.label: Extra accelerate launch arguments
extra_accelerate_launch_args.info: List of extra parameters to pass to accelerate launch

additional_parameters.label: Additional parameters
additional_parameters.info: Extra CLI flags appended to the training command (use with care).
additional_parameters.placeholder: (Optional) Use to provide additional parameters not handled by the GUI. Eg: --some_parameters "value"

debug_mode.label: Debug Mode Selection
debug_mode.info: Select debug mode for training visualization and logging. Dataset debugging is handled separately in caching settings.

dataset_config_mode.label: Dataset Configuration Method
dataset_config_mode.info: Choose how to configure your dataset: provide a TOML file or auto-generate from folder structure

dataset_config.label: Dataset Config File
dataset_config.info: REQUIRED: Path to TOML file for training. This is the file path the model will use. Must exist before starting training!

parent_folder_path.label: Parent Folder Path
parent_folder_path.info: Path to parent folder containing subfolders with images. Each subfolder can have format: [repeats]_[name] (e.g., 3_ohwx, 2_style)

create_missing_captions.label: Create Missing Captions
create_missing_captions.info: Automatically create caption files for images that don't have them

caption_strategy.label: Caption Strategy
caption_strategy.info: folder_name: Use folder name (without repeat prefix) as caption | empty: Create empty caption files

dataset_enable_bucket.label: Enable Bucketing
dataset_enable_bucket.info: Enable aspect ratio bucketing to train on images with different aspect ratios

dataset_bucket_no_upscale.label: Bucket No Upscale
dataset_bucket_no_upscale.info: Don't upscale images when bucketing (maintains original size if smaller than target)

dataset_cache_directory.label: Cache Directory Name
dataset_cache_directory.info: Cache folder name (relative) or full path (absolute). Each dataset gets its own cache directory to avoid conflicts

dataset_control_directory.label: Control Directory Name (Edit Mode)
dataset_control_directory.info:
[EDIT MODE] Directory containing control/reference images for Qwen-Image-Edit training. Only used when Model Version is edit-2509 or edit-2511 in Model Settings. Place control images in this subfolder within each dataset folder.

📁 Dataset Structure:
• Training images: dataset_folder/images/
• Control images: dataset_folder/edit_images/
• Captions: dataset_folder/images/*.txt

🖼️ File Naming:
• Single control: image1.jpg → edit_images/image1.png
• Multiple controls (Edit-2509/2511): image1.jpg → edit_images/image1_0.png, image1_1.png, image1_2.png
• Supports: .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp formats

dataset_qwen_image_edit_no_resize_contro.label: Qwen Image Edit: No Resize Control
dataset_qwen_image_edit_no_resize_contro.info: [EDIT MODE ONLY] When checked, control images keep their original size (no resizing). Use when your control images are already the correct size. Ignored in normal LoRA training.

dataset_qwen_image_edit_control_resoluti.label: Control Image Width
dataset_qwen_image_edit_control_resoluti.info: [EDIT MODE ONLY] Width for control images. 0 = use training resolution. 1024 = Official Qwen-Image-Edit default. 1328 = Optimal for Qwen models. Only used when Model Version is edit-2509/edit-2511. Cannot be used with 'No Resize Control'.

dataset_qwen_image_edit_control_resoluti.label: Control Image Height
dataset_qwen_image_edit_control_resoluti.info: [EDIT MODE ONLY] Height for control images. 0 = use training resolution. 1024 = Official Qwen-Image-Edit default. 1328 = Optimal for Qwen models. Set both width & height for custom control resolution.

auto_generate_black_control_images.label: Auto Generate Black Control Images
auto_generate_black_control_images.info: [EDIT MODE ONLY] Automatically generate pitch black PNG images as control images. Uses same filenames as training images.

generated_toml_path.label: Generated TOML Path
generated_toml_path.info: Display only. This path is auto-copied to 'Dataset Config File' field. Training ALWAYS uses the 'Dataset Config File' path.

sdpa.label: Use SDPA for CrossAttention
sdpa.info: [RECOMMENDED] PyTorch's Scaled Dot Product Attention - fastest and most memory efficient for Qwen Image. PRIORITY 1: If multiple selected, SDPA takes precedence

flash_attn.label: Use FlashAttention for CrossAttention
flash_attn.info: Memory-efficient attention implementation. Requires FlashAttention library. Enable split_attn if using this. PRIORITY 2: Used only if SDPA is disabled

sage_attn.label: Use SageAttention for CrossAttention
sage_attn.info: Alternative attention implementation. Requires SageAttention library. Enable split_attn if using this. PRIORITY 3: Used only if SDPA & FlashAttn are disabled

xformers.label: Use xformers for CrossAttention
xformers.info: Memory-efficient attention from xformers library. Enable split_attn if using this. PRIORITY 4: Lowest priority, used only if all others are disabled

flash3.label: Use FlashAttention 3
flash3.info: [EXPERIMENTAL] FlashAttention 3 support. Not confirmed to work with Qwen Image yet. Requires FlashAttention 3 library

split_attn.label: Split Attention
split_attn.info: [REQUIRED] if using FlashAttention/SageAttention/xformers/flash3. Splits attention computation to reduce memory usage

use_legacy_sdpa.label: Use Legacy PyTorch SDPA
use_legacy_sdpa.info: Leave off (recommended) to let SDPA use PyTorch's fused kernel or a verified external FlashAttention backend when the native kernel is unavailable. Enable to force the older, usually slower PyTorch SDPA path. This only applies when Use SDPA is enabled. Automatic mode falls back to PyTorch SDPA if FlashAttention cannot import, is unsupported by the GPU, or fails a CUDA forward/backward training probe.

max_train_steps.label: Max Training Steps
max_train_steps.info: Total training steps. 1600 steps ≈ 1-2 hours on RTX 4090. Ignored if Max Training Epochs is set

max_train_epochs.label: Max Training Epochs
max_train_epochs.info: [RECOMMENDED] 16 epochs for Qwen Image. Overrides max_train_steps. 1 epoch = full pass through dataset. 0 = use max_train_steps instead

max_data_loader_n_workers.label: Max DataLoader Workers
max_data_loader_n_workers.info: [RECOMMENDED] 2 recommended for Qwen Image stability. Higher values = faster data loading but more RAM usage and potential instability

persistent_data_loader_workers.label: Persistent DataLoader Workers
persistent_data_loader_workers.info: [ENABLED] Keeps data loading processes alive between epochs. Faster epoch transitions but uses more RAM

seed.label: Random Seed for Training
seed.info: 42 = reproducible results (same output every time). 0 or empty = random seed each run. Useful for comparing training runs

gradient_checkpointing.label: Enable Gradient Checkpointing
gradient_checkpointing.info: [ENABLED] Trades computation for memory. Essential for Qwen Image training. Saves ~50% VRAM but increases training time ~20%

gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offload.label: Gradient Checkpointing CPU Offload
gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offload.info: Offload activations to CPU when using gradient checkpointing. Reduces VRAM usage but slows training

gradient_accumulation_steps.label: Gradient Accumulation Steps
gradient_accumulation_steps.info: Simulate larger batch size. 1 = update every step, 4 = accumulate 4 steps then update. Useful for small VRAM

full_bf16.label: Full BF16 Training
full_bf16.info: [EXPERIMENTAL] Stores gradients in BF16 instead of FP32. Saves ~30% VRAM but may cause training instability. Requires mixed_precision='bf16'. Monitor loss carefully.

full_fp16.label: Full FP16 Training
full_fp16.info: [EXPERIMENTAL] Stores gradients in FP16 instead of FP32. Saves ~30% VRAM but has a higher risk of gradient underflow. Requires mixed_precision='fp16' and careful learning-rate tuning.

logging_dir.label: Logging Directory
logging_dir.info: Directory for training logs and TensorBoard data. Leave empty to disable logging. Example: ./logs

log_with.label: Logging Tool
log_with.info: TensorBoard = local logs, WandB = cloud tracking, 'all' = both, (none) = no logging. Requires logging_dir for TensorBoard

log_prefix.label: Log Prefix
log_prefix.info: Prefix added to log directory names with timestamp. Example: 'qwen-lora' creates 'qwen-lora-20241201120000'

log_tracker_name.label: Log Tracker Name
log_tracker_name.info: Custom name for the tracker instance. Used in TensorBoard/WandB interface. Defaults to script name

wandb_run_name.label: WandB Run Name
wandb_run_name.info: Custom name for WandB experiment. Auto-generated if empty. Only used when log_with includes 'wandb'

log_tracker_config.label: Log Tracker Config
log_tracker_config.info: Path to JSON config file for logging parameters. Advanced users only. Leave empty for defaults

wandb_api_key.label: WandB API Key
wandb_api_key.info: WandB API key for authentication. Get from wandb.ai/authorize. Can also set WANDB_API_KEY env variable
wandb_api_key.placeholder: Enter your WandB API key (optional if env var set)

log_config.label: Log Training Configuration
log_config.info: Include all training parameters in logs. Useful for experiment tracking and reproducibility

ddp_timeout.label: DDP Timeout (minutes)
ddp_timeout.info: Distributed training timeout in minutes. 0 = use default (30min). Increase if training crashes on multi-GPU setups

ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view.label: DDP Gradient as Bucket View
ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view.info: Optimization for distributed training. May improve performance but can cause instability in some cases

ddp_static_graph.label: DDP Static Graph
ddp_static_graph.info: Enables static graph optimization for distributed training. May improve performance if model architecture doesn't change

sample_every_n_steps.label: Sample Every N Steps
sample_every_n_steps.info: Generate test images every N training steps. 0 = disable

sample_at_first.label: Sample at First
sample_at_first.info: Generate test images before training starts to verify setup

sample_every_n_epochs.label: Sample Every N Epochs
sample_every_n_epochs.info: Generate test images every N epochs. 0 = disable. Overrides sample_every_n_steps

sample_prompts.label: Sample Prompts File
sample_prompts.info: Path to text/TOML/JSON file with prompts. Required for sample generation

sample_output_dir.label: Custom Sample Output Directory
sample_output_dir.info: Optional: Custom directory to save samples. If empty, uses output directory where model files will be saved

disable_prompt_enhancement.label: Disable Automatic Prompt Enhancement
disable_prompt_enhancement.info: When enabled, uses original prompts without adding Kohya format parameters

sample_guidance_scale.label: Default Guidance
sample_guidance_scale.info: Legacy/compat guidance flag (--g). Qwen training sampling is primarily controlled by Default CFG Scale (--l).

sample_discrete_flow_shift.label: Default Flow Shift
sample_discrete_flow_shift.info: Discrete flow shift (0 = use training value, 2.2 = Qwen optimal)

sample_cfg_scale.label: Default CFG Scale
sample_cfg_scale.info: Primary Qwen training sample CFG scale (--l). Set 1.0 to disable CFG.

sample_negative_prompt.label: Default Negative Prompt
sample_negative_prompt.info: Default negative prompt for all samples (can be overridden per prompt)

caching_latent_device.label: Caching Device
caching_latent_device.info: Device for latent caching. 'cuda' = GPU (faster), 'cpu' = CPU (slower but uses less VRAM)

caching_latent_batch_size.label: Caching Batch Size
caching_latent_batch_size.info: How many images to process at once. 4=conservative for 16GB VRAM, 8-16=faster with more VRAM. Reduce if OOM errors

caching_latent_num_workers.label: Data Loading Workers
caching_latent_num_workers.info: Parallel workers for loading images. 8=good default. Higher=faster loading but more RAM usage. 0=single-threaded

caching_latent_skip_existing.label: Skip Existing Cache Files
caching_latent_skip_existing.info: Skip caching if cache files already exist. Disable to force re-caching all files

caching_latent_keep_cache.label: Keep Cache Files
caching_latent_keep_cache.info: Keep cached latent files after training. Recommended to enable for faster re-training with same dataset

caching_latent_debug_mode.label: Debug Mode
caching_latent_debug_mode.info: Debug visualization for latent caching. 'None' disables display, 'image' saves debug images, 'console' prints debug info, 'video' for video models

caching_latent_console_width.label: Console Width
caching_latent_console_width.info: Terminal width for debug console output formatting. Standard terminal = 80-120 characters

caching_latent_console_back.label: Console Background
caching_latent_console_back.info: Background character for debug console visualization. Usually leave empty or use space/dot

caching_latent_console_num_images.label: Console Number of Images
caching_latent_console_num_images.info: Max images to show in debug console. 0=no limit. Useful to prevent console spam with large datasets

caching_teo_text_encoder.label: Text Encoder (Qwen2.5-VL) Path
caching_teo_text_encoder.info: Path to Qwen2.5-VL for text encoder caching. Leave empty to use the main Text Encoder path from Model Settings above
caching_teo_text_encoder.placeholder: e.g., /path/to/qwen_2.5_vl_7b.safetensors (leave empty to use main path)

caching_teo_device.label: Caching Device
caching_teo_device.info: Device for text encoder caching. 'cuda' = GPU (faster), 'cpu' = CPU (slower, use if GPU runs out of memory)

caching_teo_fp8_vl.label: Use FP8 for VL Model
caching_teo_fp8_vl.info: Use FP8 quantization during caching to save VRAM. Should match main FP8 VL setting. Enable for <16GB VRAM

caching_teo_batch_size.label: Caching Batch Size
caching_teo_batch_size.info: Text encoder batch size. 16=good default. Higher=faster but more VRAM. Reduce if getting OOM errors

caching_teo_num_workers.label: Data Loading Workers
caching_teo_num_workers.info: Parallel workers for loading text data. 8=good default. Higher=faster but more RAM usage

caching_teo_skip_existing.label: Skip Existing Cache Files
caching_teo_skip_existing.info: ✅ KEEP CHECKED: Skip if cache already exists (fast). UNCHECK ONLY to re-cache when: captions changed, text encoder changed, or cache corrupted

caching_teo_keep_cache.label: Keep Cache Files
caching_teo_keep_cache.info: ✅ KEEP CHECKED: Keep cache for faster re-training. Cache stays in cache_dir folder even if images removed from dataset

optimizer_type.label: Optimizer Type
optimizer_type.info: [RECOMMENDED] Use what preset has unless you are an expert.
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

optimizer_args.label: Optimizer Arguments
optimizer_args.info: Extra optimizer parameters as key=value pairs. Space separated. e.g. scale_parameter=False relative_step=False warmup_init=False weight_decay=0.01
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

learning_rate.label: Learning Rate
learning_rate.info: [RECOMMENDED] Don't change what preset has unless you are an expert. Lower value may learn more details in longer training, higher value may learn faster but lower quality.
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

max_grad_norm.label: Max Gradient Norm
max_grad_norm.info: Gradient clipping to prevent exploding gradients. 1.0 = good default, 0 = disabled. Higher = allow larger gradients
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_scheduler.label: Learning Rate Scheduler
lr_scheduler.info: [RECOMMENDED] 'constant' for most cases. 'cosine' = gradual decrease, 'linear' = linear decrease, 'constant_with_warmup' = warm start
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_warmup_steps.label: LR Warmup Steps
lr_warmup_steps.info: Gradually increase LR for stability. Integer = steps, float <1 = ratio of total steps. 0 = no warmup. Try 100-500 steps
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_decay_steps.label: LR Decay Steps
lr_decay_steps.info: Number of steps to decay learning rate (0 for no decay, or ratio <1 for percentage of total steps)
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_scheduler_num_cycles.label: LR Scheduler Cycles
lr_scheduler_num_cycles.info: Number of restart cycles for 'cosine_with_restarts' scheduler. More cycles = more LR restarts during training
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_scheduler_power.label: LR Scheduler Power
lr_scheduler_power.info: Polynomial decay power for 'polynomial' scheduler. 1.0 = linear, >1.0 = slower initial decay, <1.0 = faster initial decay
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_scheduler_timescale.label: LR Scheduler Timescale
lr_scheduler_timescale.info: Inverse sqrt scheduler timescale. Defaults to warmup steps. Advanced parameter, leave empty for auto
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratio.label: LR Min Ratio
lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratio.info: Minimum learning rate as ratio of initial LR. 0.1 = LR won't go below 10% of initial. 0 = can reach zero
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_scheduler_type.label: Custom Scheduler Module
lr_scheduler_type.info: Full path to custom scheduler class (e.g., 'torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR'). Leave empty to use built-in schedulers
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

lr_scheduler_args.label: Scheduler Arguments
lr_scheduler_args.info: Extra scheduler parameters as key=value pairs. Space separated. e.g. T_max=100 eta_min=1e-7 last_epoch=-1
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

fused_backward_pass.label: Fused Backward Pass [🎯 DreamBooth Only]
fused_backward_pass.info: 💾 [DreamBooth Exclusive] Advanced memory optimization that reduces VRAM usage during gradient computation by using fused operations with AdaFactor optimizer. 🎯 AUTOMATICALLY ENABLED for DreamBooth Fine-Tuning mode and DISABLED for LoRA mode (not effective). ⚠️ Requirements: Must use AdaFactor optimizer. Limitations: Disables gradient accumulation, max_grad_norm should be 0. VRAM Savings: Significant during backward pass.
parents: Learning Rate, Optimizer and Scheduler Settings

training_mode.label: Training Mode
training_mode.info: LoRA: Efficient parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Faster to train on lower VRAM GPUs with FP8 Scaled.

dit.label: DiT (Base Model) Checkpoint Path
dit.info: e.g. qwen_image_bf16.safetensors : Must be standard bf16/fp16 model. FP8 pre-quantized models NOT supported. FP8 conversion happens automatically if enabled below
dit.placeholder: Path to DiT base model checkpoint (qwen_image_bf16.safetensors)

dit_dtype.label: DiT Computation Data Type
dit_dtype.info: [HARDCODED] bfloat16 computation precision is required for Qwen Image training. FP8 settings below control weight storage only

dit_in_channels.label: DiT Input Channels
dit_in_channels.info: [DO NOT CHANGE] VAE latent channels that DiT expects. MUST be 16 for Qwen Image (VAE encodes images to 16-channel latents). Different from SD (4 channels). Changing this will cause training to fail. This represents the depth of encoded image data.

num_layers.label: Number of DiT Layers
num_layers.info: 🔧 ADVANCED: Number of transformer layers in the DiT model. Leave empty for auto-detection (60 layers for standard Qwen Image models). Only modify when using custom or pruned models. Incorrect values will cause training failure. Supported range: 1-60 layers.

text_encoder_dtype.label: Text Encoder Data Type
text_encoder_dtype.info: Data type for Qwen2.5-VL text encoder. float16 = faster, bfloat16 = better precision

vae.label: VAE Checkpoint Path
vae.info: e.g. qwen_train_vae.safetensors : REQUIRED: Path to VAE model (diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors from Qwen/Qwen-Image). NOT ComfyUI VAE!

vae_dtype.label: VAE Data Type
vae_dtype.info: Data type for VAE model. bfloat16 = Qwen Image default, float16 = faster, float32 = highest precision

vae_tiling.label: VAE Tiling
vae_tiling.info: Enable spatial tiling for VAE to reduce VRAM usage during encoding/decoding

vae_chunk_size.label: VAE Chunk Size
vae_chunk_size.info: Chunk size for CausalConv3d in VAE. Higher = faster but more VRAM. 0 = auto/disabled

vae_spatial_tile_sample_min_size.label: VAE Spatial Tile Min Size
vae_spatial_tile_sample_min_size.info: Minimum spatial tile size for VAE. Auto-enables vae_tiling if set. 0 = disabled, 256 = typical

text_encoder.label: Text Encoder (Qwen2.5-VL) Path
text_encoder.info: e.g. qwen_2.5_vl_7b_bf16.safetensors : REQUIRED: Path to Qwen2.5-VL text encoder model (qwen_2.5_vl_7b.safetensors from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI)

fp8_vl.label: Use FP8 for Text Encoder (Qwen2.5-VL)
fp8_vl.info: [🔥 RECOMMENDED for lower VRAM] FP8 quantization for Qwen2.5-VL text encoder. Reduces VRAM with <1% quality loss. MUST match caching_teo_fp8_vl setting if using cached text encoder outputs. RTX 4000+ has native FP8 support

fp8_base.label: FP8 for Base Model (DiT) [On-The-Fly Conversion]
fp8_base.info: [⚠️ ALWAYS USE WITH fp8_scaled] Converts BF16 model → FP8 during loading. Reduces VRAM usage. INPUT: Standard BF16 model file. OUTPUT: Cannot save as FP8. For pre-quantized FP8 models, leave this OFF

fp8_scaled.label: Scaled FP8 (Block-wise Scaling) [🎯 CRITICAL for Quality]
fp8_scaled.info: [✅ MUST ENABLE with fp8_base] Implements block-wise FP8 scaling for ~2-3% better quality vs naive FP8. RTX 4000+: Hardware accelerated. RTX 3000: Software emulation (same quality, 5-10% slower). Without this, expect visible quality degradation

blocks_to_swap.label: Blocks to Swap to CPU
blocks_to_swap.info: Swap DiT blocks to CPU to save VRAM. Qwen Image has 60 total blocks, max swap is 59. Higher values save more VRAM but require more RAM. Slows training significantly

guidance_scale.label: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.info: Classifier-free guidance scale. Default: 1.0. Higher values = stronger prompt adherence

img_in_txt_in_offloading.label: Image-in-Text Input Offloading
img_in_txt_in_offloading.info: Memory optimization for mixed image-text inputs. Enable for VRAM savings with complex inputs

model_version.label: Model Version
model_version.info: Select which Qwen Image variant to train. Edit variants require control images (control_directory) in your dataset TOML.

faster_model_loading.label: Faster Model Loading (Uses more RAM but speeds up model loading speed - Enable for RunPod)
faster_model_loading.info: Disables numpy memmap for faster model loading. Uses more RAM but speeds up loading, especially useful for RunPod and similar environments.

use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap.label: Use Pinned Memory for Block Swapping (Faster on Windows - Requires more RAM)
use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap.info: Uses more system RAM but speeds up training. The speed up maybe significant depending on system settings. To work, go to Advanced Graphics settings in System > Display > Graphics as in tutorial video and disable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling and restart your PC.

block_swap_h2d_only.label: H2D-Only Block Swap (LoRA)
block_swap_h2d_only.info: Streams frozen blocks host-to-device without copying them back. Requires Blocks to Swap > 0 and Gradient Checkpointing.

block_swap_ring_size.label: H2D Block Swap Ring Size
block_swap_ring_size.info: 2 overlaps transfer and compute; 1 uses the least VRAM without overlap.

compile.label: Enable torch.compile
compile.info: Enable torch.compile for faster training (requires PyTorch 2.1+, Triton for CUDA). Works with SDXL and FLUX. Disable gradient checkpointing for best results!

compile_resident_blocks_only.label: Compile Resident Blocks Only
compile_resident_blocks_only.info: Recommended for Qwen Image. Compiles permanently GPU-resident blocks while leaving swapped blocks eager; ignored when torch.compile is disabled.

compile_dynamic.label: Dynamic Shapes
compile_dynamic.info: Dynamic shape handling: auto (default), true (enable), false (disable)

compile_fullgraph.label: Fullgraph Mode
compile_fullgraph.info: Enable fullgraph mode in torch.compile (may fail with complex models)

compile_cache_size_limit.label: Cache Size Limit
compile_cache_size_limit.info: Set torch._dynamo.config.cache_size_limit (0 = use PyTorch default, typically 8-32)

timestep_sampling.label: Timestep Sampling Method
timestep_sampling.info: [RECOMMENDED] 'qwen_shift' = dynamic shift per resolution (best for Qwen). 'shift' = fixed shift. 'sigma' = musubi tuner default

discrete_flow_shift.label: Discrete Flow Shift
discrete_flow_shift.info: [NOTE] Only used with 'shift' method. Qwen Image optimal: 2.2. 'qwen_shift' automatically calculates dynamic shift (0.5-0.9) based on image resolution

flow_shift.label: Flow Shift (Advanced)
flow_shift.info: [ADVANCED] Controls noise schedule in flow matching. Default 7.0 is optimal for most cases. Higher values (8-10) = smoother but slower convergence. Lower values (5-6) = faster but may be unstable. Only change if you understand flow matching theory.

weighting_scheme.label: Weighting Scheme
weighting_scheme.info: [RECOMMENDED] 'none' recommended for Qwen Image. Advanced: 'logit_normal' for different timestep emphasis, 'mode' for SD3-style weighting

logit_mean.label: Logit Mean
logit_mean.info: Mean for 'logit_normal' weighting. 0.0=balanced, negative=favor early timesteps, positive=favor late timesteps

logit_std.label: Logit Std
logit_std.info: Standard deviation for 'logit_normal'. 1.0=normal distribution, <1.0=concentrated, >1.0=spread out timestep sampling

mode_scale.label: Mode Scale
mode_scale.info: Scale for 'mode' weighting scheme. Default 1.29 from SD3. Higher values = more emphasis on certain timesteps

sigmoid_scale.label: Sigmoid Scale
sigmoid_scale.info: Scale factor for sigmoid timestep sampling. Only used with 'sigmoid' or some shift methods. Default: 1.0

min_timestep.label: Min Timestep
min_timestep.info: Minimum timestep for training (0-999). Leave empty for default (0). Constrains timestep sampling range

max_timestep.label: Max Timestep
max_timestep.info: Maximum timestep for training (1-1000). Leave empty for default (1000). Constrains timestep sampling range

preserve_distribution_shape.label: Preserve Distribution Shape
preserve_distribution_shape.info: Use rejection sampling to preserve original timestep distribution when using min/max timestep constraints

num_timestep_buckets.label: Num Timestep Buckets

gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offload.info: Offload activations to CPU when using gradient checkpointing. Reduces VRAM at the cost of speed

gradient_accumulation_steps.label: Gradient Accumulation Steps
gradient_accumulation_steps.info: Number of steps to accumulate gradients before backward pass

full_bf16.label: Full BF16 Training
full_bf16.info: [EXPERIMENTAL] Stores gradients in BF16 instead of FP32. Saves ~30% VRAM but may cause training instability. Requires mixed_precision='bf16'. Monitor loss carefully.

full_fp16.label: Full FP16 Training
full_fp16.info: [EXPERIMENTAL] Stores gradients in FP16 instead of FP32. Saves ~30% VRAM but has a higher risk of gradient underflow. Requires mixed_precision='fp16' and careful learning-rate tuning.

fused_backward_pass.label: Fused Backward Pass
fused_backward_pass.info: Adafactor only; lowest memory. Needs accumulation steps = 1.

block_swap_optimizer_patch_params.label: Patch Optimizer for Block Swap
block_swap_optimizer_patch_params.info: For AdamW/Adafactor without fused backward when blocks are swapped.

logging_dir.label: Logging Directory
logging_dir.info: Required when log_with is tensorboard or all.

log_with.label: Logging Tool
log_with.info: Select the logging tool to use. (none) = no logging

log_prefix.label: Log Directory Prefix
log_prefix.info: Optional. Prefix for generated log directories.

log_tracker_name.label: Log Tracker Name
log_tracker_name.info: Optional. Custom tracker name shown in logs.
log_tracker_name.placeholder: Name of the tracker used for logging

wandb_run_name.label: WandB Run Name
wandb_run_name.info: Optional. Run name shown in WandB.
wandb_run_name.placeholder: Name of the specific WandB session

log_tracker_config.label: Log Tracker Config
log_tracker_config.info: Optional. Path to a tracker config file.
log_tracker_config.placeholder: Path to the tracker config file for logging

wandb_api_key.label: WandB API Key
wandb_api_key.info: Optional. If set, logs in before training.
wandb_api_key.placeholder: Optional: Specify WandB API key to log in before training

log_config.label: Log Training Configuration
log_config.info: Log the training configuration to the logging directory

ddp_timeout.label: DDP Timeout (minutes)
ddp_timeout.info: Set DDP timeout in minutes (None for default)

ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view.label: Enable Gradient as Bucket View for DDP

sample_prompts.label: Sample Prompts File
sample_prompts.info: One prompt per line; supports --w --h --s --d --l --n --ci flags.

disable_prompt_enhancement.label: Disable Prompt Defaults
disable_prompt_enhancement.info: Do not append the defaults below to each prompt line.

model_type.label: Model Type
model_type.info: full = base model; dev = distilled dev model.

task.label: Task
task.info: t2i = text-to-image; i2i = control/reference conditioned (also trains the visual encoder).

skip_t2i_visual_dummy.label: Skip T2I Visual Dummy Forward
skip_t2i_visual_dummy.info: Faster single-GPU t2i training. Disable only for multi-GPU FSDP.

dino_loss_weight.label: DINOv3 Perceptual Loss Weight
dino_loss_weight.info: 0 disables. Needs the optional sensecraft[dinov3] package.

caching_teo_fp8_te.label: Cache FP8 Text Embeddings
caching_teo_fp8_te.info: Caches initial text token embeddings in FP8 (needs the checkpoint).

freeze_text_embeddings.label: Freeze Text Token Embeddings
freeze_text_embeddings.info: Keeps the 0.6B-parameter token-embedding table frozen (like not training a text encoder); every transformer layer still trains. Its gradient and optimizer update otherwise need several GB at once, so this lets full fine-tuning fit smaller GPUs.

optimizer_args.label: Optimizer Arguments
optimizer_args.info: ⚠️ Space-separated arguments ONLY (no commas). Commas will be automatically removed when saving config.
optimizer_args.placeholder: Additional arguments for optimizer. Space separated. e.g. "scale_parameter=False relative_step=False weight_decay=0.01"

max_grad_norm.label: Max Gradient Norm
max_grad_norm.info: Maximum gradient norm (0 for no clipping)

lr_scheduler.label: Learning Rate Scheduler
lr_scheduler.info: Select the learning rate scheduler to use

lr_warmup_steps.label: LR Warmup Steps
lr_warmup_steps.info: Number of warmup steps or ratio of train steps (e.g., 0.1 for 10%)

lr_decay_steps.label: LR Decay Steps
lr_decay_steps.info: Number of decay steps or ratio of train steps (e.g., 0.1 for 10%)

lr_scheduler_num_cycles.label: LR Scheduler Num Cycles
lr_scheduler_num_cycles.info: Number of restarts for cosine scheduler with restarts

lr_scheduler_timescale.label: LR Scheduler Timescale
lr_scheduler_timescale.info: Timescale for inverse sqrt scheduler (defaults to num_warmup_steps)

lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratio.label: LR Scheduler Min LR Ratio
lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratio.info: Minimum LR as a ratio of initial LR for cosine with min LR scheduler

lr_scheduler_type.label: LR Scheduler Type
lr_scheduler_type.info: Optional. Custom scheduler module or class path (overrides preset selection).

lr_scheduler_args.label: LR Scheduler Arguments
lr_scheduler_args.info: Space-separated key=value args passed to the scheduler.
lr_scheduler_args.placeholder: Additional arguments for scheduler. Space separated. e.g. "T_max=100 eta_min=1e-7 last_epoch=-1"

no_metadata.label: Do Not Save Metadata
no_metadata.info: Disable saving metadata into the output model file.

network_weights.label: Network Weights (LoRA Weights)
network_weights.info: Optional. Load existing LoRA weights before training.
network_weights.placeholder: Path to pretrained LoRA weights for network

network_module.label: Network Module (LoRA Type)
network_module.info: LoRA module path used by training (e.g., networks.lora_flux_2 or networks.lora_zimage).

network_dim.label: Network Dimensions (LoRA Rank)
network_dim.info: LoRA rank/dimensions (depends on the module type)

network_alpha.label: Network Alpha (LoRA Alpha)
network_alpha.info: Alpha value for LoRA weight scaling (default: 1)

network_dropout.label: Network Dropout (LoRA Dropout)
network_dropout.info: LoRA dropout rate (0 or None for no dropout, 1 drops all neurons)

network_args.label: Network Arguments (LoRA Args)
network_args.info: Space-separated key=value args passed to the LoRA module.
network_args.placeholder: Additional LoRA network arguments. Space separated. e.g. "conv_dim=4 conv_alpha=1 algo=locon"

training_comment.label: Training Comment
training_comment.placeholder: Arbitrary comment string to store in metadata

scale_weight_norms.label: Scale Weight Norms
scale_weight_norms.info: Scaling factor for weights (1 is a good starting point)

base_weights.label: Base Weights (LoRA Base)
base_weights.info: Optional. LoRA files merged into the model before training; separate several with ';' (or quote each path).
base_weights.placeholder: Paths to LoRA weights to merge into the model before training

base_weights_multiplier.label: Base Weights Multiplier
base_weights_multiplier.info: Optional. One multiplier per base weight, in the same order, separated by spaces (e.g. 1 0.5).
base_weights_multiplier.placeholder: Multipliers for network weights to merge into the model before training

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.info: Required. Folder where checkpoints and config will be written.
output_dir.placeholder: Directory to save the trained model

output_name.label: Output Name
output_name.info: Required. Base filename for saved checkpoints (extension is added automatically).
output_name.placeholder: Base name of the trained model file (excluding extension)

resume.label: Resume Training State
resume.info: Optional. Path to a saved state to resume training from.
resume.placeholder: Path to saved state to resume training

save_precision.label: LoRA Save Precision
save_precision.info: Precision used for saved LoRA weights. BF16 is the default and keeps files about half the size of FP32 without reducing LoRA rank.

save_every_n_epochs.label: Save Every N Epochs
save_every_n_epochs.info: Save a checkpoint every N epochs

save_last_n_epochs.label: Save Last N Epochs
save_last_n_epochs.info: Save only the last N checkpoints when saving every N epochs

save_every_n_steps.label: Save Every N Steps
save_every_n_steps.info: Save a checkpoint every N steps

save_last_n_steps.label: Save Last N Steps
save_last_n_steps.info: Save checkpoints until N steps elapsed (remove older ones afterward)

save_last_n_epochs_state.label: Save Last N Epochs State
save_last_n_epochs_state.info: Save states of the last N epochs (overrides save_last_n_epochs)

save_last_n_steps_state.label: Save Last N Steps State
save_last_n_steps_state.info: Save states until N steps elapsed (overrides save_last_n_steps)

save_state.label: Save Training State
save_state.info: Save optimizer and training state (needed for resume).

save_state_on_train_end.label: Save State on Train End
save_state_on_train_end.info: Save state at the end of training even if periodic saving is disabled.

mem_eff_save.label: Memory Efficient Save
mem_eff_save.info: Reduces RAM usage when the selected full fine-tuning backend supports memory-efficient checkpoint saving. Optimizer state saves still use the normal method.

metadata_author.label: Metadata author
metadata_author.info: Optional author name stored in metadata.

metadata_license.label: Metadata license
metadata_license.info: Optional license string stored in metadata.

metadata_tags.label: Metadata tags
metadata_tags.info: Optional comma-separated tags stored in metadata.
metadata_tags.placeholder: (optional) tags for model metadata, separated by comma

metadata_title.label: Metadata title
metadata_title.info: Optional title stored in the model metadata.
metadata_title.placeholder: (optional) title for model metadata (default is output_name)

metadata_reso.label: Metadata Resolution
metadata_reso.placeholder: (optional) resolution for model metadata, e.g., 1024,1024 or 720,1280

metadata_arch.label: Metadata Architecture
metadata_arch.placeholder: (optional) custom architecture string for model metadata

huggingface_token.label: Huggingface token
huggingface_token.info: Access token with write permissions for the repo.

huggingface_repo_type.label: Huggingface repo type
huggingface_repo_type.info: Repo type (e.g., model or dataset). Leave empty for default.

huggingface_repo_visibility.label: Huggingface repo visibility
huggingface_repo_visibility.info: Visibility setting: public or private (leave empty to keep repo default).

huggingface_path_in_repo.label: Huggingface path in repo
huggingface_path_in_repo.info: Optional subfolder path inside the repo to upload files to.

save_state_to_huggingface.label: Save state to huggingface
save_state_to_huggingface.info: Upload training state/checkpoints to Hugging Face after save.

resume_from_huggingface.label: Resume from huggingface
resume_from_huggingface.info: Optional HF resume spec. Leave empty for local resume. Local filesystem paths belong in 'Resume Training State'.

async_upload.label: Async upload
async_upload.info: Upload to Hugging Face asynchronously to avoid blocking training.

mixed_precision.label: Mixed precision
mixed_precision.info: Use mixed precision for training. bf16 is generally recommended for FLUX/Z-Image on supported GPUs; fp16 may be less stable.

num_cpu_threads_per_process.label: Number of CPU threads per core
num_cpu_threads_per_process.info: CPU threads per process used by accelerate (data loading and preprocessing).

num_processes.label: Number of processes
num_processes.info: The total number of processes to be launched in parallel.

num_machines.label: Number of machines
num_machines.info: The total number of machines used in this training.

multi_gpu.label: Multi GPU
multi_gpu.info: Whether or not this should launch a distributed GPU training.

gpu_ids.label: GPU IDs
gpu_ids.info: Comma-separated GPU IDs to use on this machine (e.g., 0,1). Leave empty for auto.

main_process_port.label: Main process port
main_process_port.info: Port of the main process for multi-GPU runs (0 = accelerate's default 29500).

dynamo_backend.label: Dynamo backend
dynamo_backend.info: Backend for torch dynamo JIT. Use 'no' to disable (recommended for stability), or 'inductor' for PyTorch 2.x optimizations.

dynamo_mode.label: Dynamo mode
dynamo_mode.info: Choose a mode to optimize your training with dynamo. Leave empty for default.

dynamo_use_fullgraph.label: Dynamo use fullgraph
dynamo_use_fullgraph.info: Whether to use full graph mode for dynamo or it is ok to break model into several subgraphs

dynamo_use_dynamic.label: Dynamo use dynamic
dynamo_use_dynamic.info: Whether to enable dynamic shape tracing.

extra_accelerate_launch_args.label: Extra accelerate launch arguments
extra_accelerate_launch_args.info: List of extra parameters to pass to accelerate launch

additional_parameters.label: Additional parameters
additional_parameters.info: Extra CLI flags appended to the training command (use with care).
additional_parameters.placeholder: (Optional) Use to provide additional parameters not handled by the GUI. Eg: --some_parameters "value"

debug_mode.label: Debug Mode Selection
debug_mode.info: Select debug mode for training visualization and logging. Dataset debugging is handled separately in caching settings.

dataset_config_mode.label: Dataset Configuration Method
dataset_config_mode.info: Choose how to configure your dataset: provide a TOML file or auto-generate from folder structure

dataset_config.label: Dataset Config File
dataset_config.info: REQUIRED: Path to TOML file for training. This is the file path the model will use. Must exist before starting training!

parent_folder_path.label: Parent Folder Path
parent_folder_path.info: Path to parent folder with subfolder(s) containing videos/images AND their caption files together. Simplest: Create one folder named 1_[name] (e.g., 1_character_videos). Captions MUST be in SAME folder as media!

dataset_resolution_width.label: Resolution Width
dataset_resolution_width.info: Width of training videos/images. Optimal resolutions: 960×960, 1280×720, 720×1280

dataset_resolution_height.label: Resolution Height
dataset_resolution_height.info: Height of training videos/images. Optimal resolutions: 960×960, 1280×720, 720×1280

create_missing_captions.label: Create Missing Captions
create_missing_captions.info: Automatically create caption files for videos/images that don't have them

caption_strategy.label: Caption Strategy
caption_strategy.info: folder_name: Use folder name (without repeat prefix) as caption | empty: Create empty caption files

dataset_enable_bucket.label: Enable Bucketing
dataset_enable_bucket.info: Enable aspect ratio bucketing to train on videos/images with different aspect ratios

dataset_bucket_no_upscale.label: Bucket No Upscale
dataset_bucket_no_upscale.info: Don't upscale videos/images when bucketing (maintains original size if smaller than target)

dataset_cache_directory.label: Cache Directory Name
dataset_cache_directory.info: Cache folder name (relative) or full path (absolute). Each dataset gets its own cache directory to avoid conflicts

generated_toml_path.label: Generated TOML Path
generated_toml_path.info: Display only. This path is auto-copied to 'Dataset Config File' field. Training ALWAYS uses the 'Dataset Config File' path.

frame_extraction.label: Frame Extraction Method
frame_extraction.info:
🎯 **head** (Recommended): Extract frames from the beginning of video
📦 **chunk**: Split video into non-overlapping chunks
🔄 **slide**: Sliding window extraction with overlap
📊 **uniform**: Sample frames uniformly across video
🎬 **full**: Use all available frames (up to max_frames)

frame_stride.label: Frame Stride
frame_stride.info: Step size for sliding window extraction (only used with 'slide' method)

frame_sample.label: Frame Sample Count
frame_sample.info: Number of samples to extract (only used with 'uniform' method)

target_frames.label: Target Frames
target_frames.info: Target video frame count written into the generated dataset TOML as target_frames=[N]. For WAN/Hunyuan, valid values are N×4+1 (1, 5, 9, 13, ..., 81).

auto_normalize_target_frames.label: Auto Normalize Target Frames
auto_normalize_target_frames.info: When enabled, the generator scans your dataset videos and clamps Target Frames down to the minimum video length found (after optional FPS conversion), then rounds to N×4+1. This prevents shorter videos from being skipped. Scanning can take time on large datasets.

max_frames.label: Maximum Frames
max_frames.info: Maximum number of frames to extract from any video (used with 'full' method)

source_fps.label: Source FPS (Optional)
source_fps.info: Original video FPS for frame rate conversion. Set to 0 or leave empty for automatic detection

training_mode.label: Training Mode
training_mode.info: The installed Wan backend supports network/LoRA training.

task.label: Wan Model Type
task.info: Choose your Wan model variant based on version, use case and hardware capabilities
choices: t2v-14B - Text-to-Video 14B (Wan 2.1 Standard) - 38 Max Block Swap
t2v-1.3B - Text-to-Video 1.3B (Wan 2.1 Faster/Smaller) - 28 Max Block Swap
i2v-14B - Image-to-Video 14B (Wan 2.1 Standard) - 38 Max Block Swap
t2i-14B - Text-to-Image 14B (Wan 2.1 Standard) - 38 Max Block Swap
t2v-1.3B-FC - Text-to-Video 1.3B Fun-Control (Wan 2.1) - 28 Max Block Swap
t2v-14B-FC - Text-to-Video 14B Fun-Control (Wan 2.1) - 38 Max Block Swap
i2v-14B-FC - Image-to-Video 14B Fun-Control (Wan 2.1) - 38 Max Block Swap
t2v-A14B - Text-to-Video Advanced Dual-Model (Wan 2.2) - 38 Max Block Swap
i2v-A14B - Image-to-Video Advanced Dual-Model (Wan 2.2) - 38 Max Block Swap

dit.label: DiT Model Path (Low Noise / Main Model)
dit.info: ✨ REQUIRED: Path to main DiT checkpoint (.safetensors). For Wan 2.2 dual training, this serves as the LOW NOISE model (fine details). For single model training, this is the only model used.

vae.label: VAE Model Path
vae.info: REQUIRED: Use Wan2.1_VAE.pth for ALL models (including Wan 2.2 Advanced). Supports .pth and .safetensors formats.

t5.label: T5 Text Encoder Path
t5.info: REQUIRED: Path to T5 text encoder. Supports both .safetensors and .pth formats (recommended: umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.safetensors)

clip.label: CLIP Vision Model Path
clip.info: REQUIRED ONLY for: i2v-14B, flf2v-14B, i2v-14B-FC. NOT required for: all T2V models (t2v-14B, t2v-1.3B, t2v-A14B), T2I (t2i-14B), i2v-A14B, t2v-FC models. Supports .safetensors/.pth (recommended: models_clip_open-clip-xlm-roberta-large-vit-huge-14.safetensors)

dit_high_noise.label: High Noise DiT Path (Wan 2.2 Advanced Only)
dit_high_noise.info: 🔥 HIGH NOISE MODEL: Path to high noise DiT for t2v-A14B/i2v-A14B. Leave EMPTY for single-model training (Wan 2.1 style). Fill BOTH paths for dual-model training (best quality).

timestep_boundary.label: Timestep Boundary (Dual-Model Switch Point)
timestep_boundary.info: ⚡ SWITCH POINT: When to switch from high→low noise model. Leave 0 for auto-detect (uses model default), 0.3=switch at 30%, 0.5=switch at 50%. Only used when High Noise DiT path is provided.

offload_inactive_dit.label: Offload Inactive DiT to CPU
offload_inactive_dit.info: 💾 MEMORY SAVER: Move inactive model to CPU during dual training. Reduces memory usage but adds model swapping time. Useful for systems with limited GPU memory.

dit_dtype.label: DiT Data Type
dit_dtype.info: bfloat16=best quality (recommended), float16=faster but may be unstable

text_encoder_dtype.label: Text Encoder Data Type
text_encoder_dtype.info: Data type for T5 text encoder

clip_vision_dtype.label: CLIP Vision Data Type
clip_vision_dtype.info: Data type for CLIP vision encoder

fp8_base.label: FP8 Base Model
fp8_base.info: Enable FP8 for DiT model to reduce memory usage (requires fp8_scaled=true)

fp8_scaled.label: FP8 Scaled
fp8_scaled.info: REQUIRED when fp8_base=true, provides better quality than standard FP8

fp8_t5.label: FP8 T5 Text Encoder
fp8_t5.info: Enable FP8 for T5 text encoder to reduce memory usage

blocks_to_swap.label: Blocks to Swap
blocks_to_swap.info: Number of transformer blocks to swap to CPU (0=disabled, higher values save GPU memory but require more system RAM)

use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap.label: Use Pinned Memory for Block Swapping (Faster on Windows - Requires more RAM)
use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap.info: Uses more system RAM but speeds up training. The speed up maybe significant depending on system settings. To work, go to Advanced Graphics settings in System > Display > Graphics as in tutorial video and disable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling and restart your PC. Only effective when blocks_to_swap > 0

block_swap_h2d_only.label: H2D-Only Block Swap (LoRA)
block_swap_h2d_only.info: Streams frozen blocks host-to-device without copying them back. Requires Blocks to Swap > 0 and Gradient Checkpointing. Use standard block swap for Wan 2.2 dual-DiT training.

block_swap_ring_size.label: H2D Block Swap Ring Size
block_swap_ring_size.info: 2 overlaps transfer and compute; 1 uses the least VRAM without overlap.

compile.label: Enable torch.compile
compile.info: Enable torch.compile for faster training (requires PyTorch 2.1+, Triton for CUDA). Works with SDXL and FLUX. Disable gradient checkpointing for best results!

compile_resident_blocks_only.label: Compile Resident Blocks Only
compile_resident_blocks_only.info: Compile only blocks that stay on the GPU while block swapping. Enabled by default for Wan 2.2; Wan 2.1 keeps the standard compile path.

compile_dynamic.label: Dynamic Shapes
compile_dynamic.info: Dynamic shape handling: auto (default), true (enable), false (disable)

compile_fullgraph.label: Fullgraph Mode
compile_fullgraph.info: Enable fullgraph mode in torch.compile (may fail with complex models)

compile_cache_size_limit.label: Cache Size Limit
compile_cache_size_limit.info: Set torch._dynamo.config.cache_size_limit (0 = use PyTorch default, typically 8-32)

vae_tiling.label: VAE Tiling
vae_tiling.info: Enable spatial tiling to reduce memory usage during VAE operations

vae_spatial_tile_sample_min_size.label: VAE Spatial Tile Min Size
vae_spatial_tile_sample_min_size.info: Minimum sample size for VAE spatial tiling. Default: 256. Lower=more VRAM savings. Only used when VAE Tiling is enabled

vae_cache_cpu.label: Cache VAE Features on CPU
vae_cache_cpu.info: Cache VAE features on CPU to reduce GPU memory usage

num_frames.label: Number of Frames
num_frames.info: Number of frames for video training (81 is default for Wan models)

one_frame.label: One Frame Training (Experimental)
one_frame.info: 🧪 EXPERIMENTAL: Enable for image-to-image transformations using video models. NOT needed for mixed video+image datasets. Requires I2V/FLF2V models + LoRA training. See Dataset Preparation Details for full explanation.

force_v2_1_time_embedding.label: Force Wan 2.1 Time Embedding
force_v2_1_time_embedding.info: Force using 2.1 style time embedding even for Wan 2.2 models

timestep_sampling.label: Timestep Sampling Method
timestep_sampling.info: 🎯 How to sample timesteps. 'sigma' is default and works best for most cases

discrete_flow_shift.label: Discrete Flow Shift
discrete_flow_shift.info: ⚡ CRITICAL: Wan 2.2 T2V-A14B needs 12.0, I2V-A14B needs 5.0, Wan 2.1 needs 1.0. Default: 1.0

min_timestep.label: Minimum Timestep
min_timestep.info: 🔽 Start of timestep range (0-999). Leave empty for default (0). Use for focused training

max_timestep.label: Maximum Timestep
max_timestep.info: 🔼 End of timestep range (1-1000). Leave empty for default (1000). Use for focused training

num_timestep_buckets.label: Timestep Buckets (Stratified Sampling)
num_timestep_buckets.info: 📊 Enable stratified sampling. Set to 10-20 for small datasets (<100 videos). Leave empty to disable

sigmoid_scale.label: Sigmoid Scale
sigmoid_scale.info: 📈 Scale for sigmoid timestep sampling. Only used when method is 'sigmoid' or 'shift'. Default: 1.0

preserve_distribution_shape.label: Preserve Distribution Shape
preserve_distribution_shape.info: 🎨 Use rejection sampling to preserve original distribution when min/max timestep is set. Disable for simple scaling

show_timesteps.label: Show Timesteps (Debug)
show_timesteps.info: 🔍 Debug: Visualize timestep distribution. Training will stop after visualization

weighting_scheme.label: Weighting Scheme
weighting_scheme.info: 🎚️ How to weight losses at different noise levels. 'none' = all equal (recommended). Default: none

logit_mean.label: Logit Mean
logit_mean.info: 📊 Mean for logit normal distribution (only used with scheme=logit_normal). Default: 0.0

logit_std.label: Logit Standard Deviation
logit_std.info: 📊 Std dev for logit normal distribution (only used with scheme=logit_normal). Default: 1.0

mode_scale.label: Mode Scale
mode_scale.info: 📈 Scale for mode weighting (only used with scheme=mode). Default: 1.29

cuda_allow_tf32.label: Allow TF32 on Ampere+ GPUs
cuda_allow_tf32.info: ⚡ Enable TF32 precision on NVIDIA Ampere GPUs (RTX 30XX, 40XX, A100). ~10-20% faster with minimal quality loss. Default: False

cuda_cudnn_benchmark.label: Enable cuDNN Benchmark
cuda_cudnn_benchmark.info: 🔧 Auto-tune cuDNN algorithms for best performance. Enable if input sizes are consistent. Adds ~30s startup. Default: False

disable_numpy_memmap.label: Disable Numpy Memory Mapping
disable_numpy_memmap.info: 🔧 Disable numpy memmap for model loading (Wan/FramePack/Qwen-Image only). Increases RAM usage but may speed up loading. Default: False

img_in_txt_in_offloading.label: Offload img_in & txt_in to CPU
img_in_txt_in_offloading.info: 💾 Offload img_in and txt_in layers to CPU to save VRAM. May slow down training. Default: False

use_legacy_sdpa.label: Use Legacy PyTorch SDPA
use_legacy_sdpa.info: Leave off (recommended) to let SDPA use PyTorch's fused kernel or a verified external FlashAttention backend when the native kernel is unavailable. Enable to force the older, usually slower PyTorch SDPA path. This only applies when Use SDPA is enabled. Automatic mode falls back to PyTorch SDPA if FlashAttention cannot import, is unsupported by the GPU, or fails a CUDA forward/backward training probe.

max_data_loader_n_workers.label: Max DataLoader Workers
max_data_loader_n_workers.info: Lower values reduce RAM usage and speed up epoch start

persistent_data_loader_workers.label: Persistent DataLoader Workers
persistent_data_loader_workers.info: Keep DataLoader workers alive between epochs

seed.label: Random Seed for Training
seed.info: Optional: set a fixed seed for reproducibility

gradient_checkpointing.label: Enable Gradient Checkpointing
gradient_checkpointing.info: Enable gradient checkpointing for memory savings

gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offload.label: Gradient Checkpointing CPU Offload
gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offload.info: Offload activations to CPU when using gradient checkpointing. Reduces VRAM at the cost of speed

gradient_accumulation_steps.label: Gradient Accumulation Steps
gradient_accumulation_steps.info: Number of steps to accumulate gradients before backward pass

full_bf16.label: Full BF16 Training
full_bf16.info: [EXPERIMENTAL] Stores gradients in BF16 instead of FP32. Saves ~30% VRAM but may cause training instability. Requires mixed_precision='bf16'. Monitor loss carefully.

full_fp16.label: Full FP16 Training
full_fp16.info: [EXPERIMENTAL] Stores gradients in FP16 instead of FP32. Saves ~30% VRAM but has a higher risk of gradient underflow. Requires mixed_precision='fp16' and careful learning-rate tuning.

logging_dir.label: Logging Directory
logging_dir.info: Required when log_with is tensorboard or all.

log_with.label: Logging Tool

log_prefix.label: Log Directory Prefix

log_tracker_name.label: Log Tracker Name

wandb_run_name.label: WandB Run Name

log_tracker_config.label: Log Tracker Config

wandb_api_key.label: WandB API Key

log_config.label: Log Training Configuration

ddp_timeout.label: DDP Timeout (minutes)

ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view.label: Enable Gradient as Bucket View for DDP

sample_every_n_steps.label: Sample Every N Steps

sample_every_n_epochs.label: Sample Every N Epochs
sample_every_n_epochs.info: Generate test videos every N epochs. 0 = disable. Overrides sample_every_n_steps

sample_at_first.label: Sample at First
sample_at_first.info: Generate test videos before training starts to verify setup

sample_prompts.label: Sample Prompts File
sample_prompts.info: Path to text/TOML/JSON file with prompts. Required for sample generation

sample_output_dir.label: Custom Sample Output Directory
sample_output_dir.info: Optional: Custom directory to save samples. If empty, uses output directory where model files will be saved

disable_prompt_enhancement.label: Disable Automatic Prompt Enhancement
disable_prompt_enhancement.info: When enabled, uses original prompts without adding Kohya format parameters

sample_num_frames.label: Default Number of Frames
sample_num_frames.info: Number of frames in sample videos (Wan optimal: 81)

sample_steps.label: Default Steps
sample_steps.info: Number of inference steps for sample generation

sample_guidance_scale.label: Default Guidance Scale
sample_guidance_scale.info: Default CFG scale for WAN training samples (written as --l in prompts; Wan optimal: 7.0)

caching_latent_device.label: Device
caching_latent_device.placeholder: Device to use (default is CUDA if available)

caching_latent_batch_size.label: Batch Size
caching_latent_batch_size.info: Override dataset config if dataset batch size > this

caching_latent_keep_cache.label: Keep Cache
caching_latent_keep_cache.info: Keep cache files not in dataset

caching_latent_debug_mode.label: Debug Mode
caching_latent_debug_mode.info: ⚠️ WARNING: When enabled, this ONLY shows debug info and does NOT cache latents. Use 'None' for actual caching, or run debug separately first.

caching_latent_console_num_images.label: Number of Images
caching_latent_console_num_images.info: Number of images to show for each dataset in debug mode

caching_teo_device.label: Device
caching_teo_device.placeholder: Device to use (default is CUDA if available)

caching_teo_batch_size.label: Batch Size
caching_teo_batch_size.info: Override dataset config if dataset batch size > this

caching_teo_skip_existing.label: Skip Existing
caching_teo_skip_existing.info: ✅ RECOMMENDED: Skip if cache already exists. Uncheck to re-cache (needed when: changing captions, changing text encoder model, or cache is corrupted)

caching_teo_keep_cache.label: Keep Cache
caching_teo_keep_cache.info: ✅ RECOMMENDED: Keep old cache files when images are removed from dataset. Uncheck to delete orphaned cache files

optimizer_args.label: Optimizer Arguments
optimizer_args.info: ⚠️ Space-separated arguments ONLY (no commas). Commas will be automatically removed when saving config.
optimizer_args.placeholder: Additional arguments for optimizer. Space separated. e.g. "scale_parameter=False relative_step=False weight_decay=0.01"

max_grad_norm.label: Max Gradient Norm
max_grad_norm.info: Maximum gradient norm (0 for no clipping)

lr_scheduler.label: Learning Rate Scheduler
lr_scheduler.info: Select the learning rate scheduler to use

lr_warmup_steps.label: LR Warmup Steps
lr_warmup_steps.info: Number of warmup steps or ratio of train steps (e.g., 0.1 for 10%)

lr_decay_steps.label: LR Decay Steps
lr_decay_steps.info: Number of decay steps or ratio of train steps (e.g., 0.1 for 10%)

lr_scheduler_num_cycles.label: LR Scheduler Num Cycles
lr_scheduler_num_cycles.info: Number of restarts for cosine scheduler with restarts

lr_scheduler_timescale.label: LR Scheduler Timescale
lr_scheduler_timescale.info: Timescale for inverse sqrt scheduler (defaults to num_warmup_steps)

lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratio.label: LR Scheduler Min LR Ratio
lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratio.info: Minimum LR as a ratio of initial LR for cosine with min LR scheduler

lr_scheduler_type.label: LR Scheduler Type
lr_scheduler_type.info: Optional. Custom scheduler module or class path (overrides preset selection).

lr_scheduler_args.label: LR Scheduler Arguments
lr_scheduler_args.info: Space-separated key=value args passed to the scheduler.

no_metadata.label: Do Not Save Metadata
no_metadata.info: Disable saving metadata into the output model file.

network_weights.info: Optional. Load existing LoRA weights before training.

network_module.label: Network Module (LoRA Type)
network_module.info: LoRA module path used by training (e.g., networks.lora_flux_2 or networks.lora_zimage).

network_dim.label: Network Dimensions (LoRA Rank)
network_dim.info: LoRA rank/dimensions (depends on the module type)

network_alpha.label: Network Alpha (LoRA Alpha)
network_alpha.info: Alpha value for LoRA weight scaling (default: 1)

network_dropout.label: Network Dropout (LoRA Dropout)
network_dropout.info: LoRA dropout rate (0 or None for no dropout, 1 drops all neurons)

network_args.label: Network Arguments (LoRA Args)
network_args.info: Space-separated key=value args passed to the LoRA module.
network_args.placeholder: Additional LoRA network arguments. Space separated. e.g. "conv_dim=4 conv_alpha=1 algo=locon"

training_comment.label: Training Comment
training_comment.placeholder: Arbitrary comment string to store in metadata

scale_weight_norms.label: Scale Weight Norms
scale_weight_norms.info: Scaling factor for weights (1 is a good starting point)

base_weights.label: Base Weights (LoRA Base)
base_weights.info: Optional. LoRA files merged into the model before training; separate several with ';' (or quote each path).
base_weights.placeholder: Paths to LoRA weights to merge into the model before training

base_weights_multiplier.label: Base Weights Multiplier
base_weights_multiplier.info: Optional. One multiplier per base weight, in the same order, separated by spaces (e.g. 1 0.5).
base_weights_multiplier.placeholder: Multipliers for network weights to merge into the model before training

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.info: Required. Folder where checkpoints and config will be written.

save_precision.label: LoRA Save Precision
save_precision.info: Precision used for saved LoRA weights. BF16 is the default and keeps files about half the size of FP32 without reducing LoRA rank.

save_last_n_epochs.info: Save only the last N checkpoints when saving every N epochs

save_last_n_epochs_state.label: Save Last N Epochs State
save_last_n_epochs_state.info: Save states of the last N epochs (overrides save_last_n_epochs)

save_last_n_steps.info: Save checkpoints until N steps elapsed (remove older ones afterward)

save_last_n_steps_state.info: Save states until N steps elapsed (overrides save_last_n_steps)

save_state.info: Save optimizer and training state (needed for resume).

save_state_on_train_end.info: Save state at the end of training even if periodic saving is disabled.

huggingface_token.label: Huggingface token
huggingface_token.info: Access token with write permissions for the repo.

huggingface_repo_type.label: Huggingface repo type
huggingface_repo_type.info: Repo type (e.g., model or dataset). Leave empty for default.

huggingface_repo_visibility.label: Huggingface repo visibility
huggingface_repo_visibility.info: Visibility setting: public or private (leave empty to keep repo default).

huggingface_path_in_repo.label: Huggingface path in repo
huggingface_path_in_repo.info: Optional subfolder path inside the repo to upload files to.

save_state_to_huggingface.label: Save state to huggingface
save_state_to_huggingface.info: Upload training state/checkpoints to Hugging Face after save.

resume_from_huggingface.label: Resume from huggingface
resume_from_huggingface.info: Optional HF resume spec. Leave empty for local resume. Local filesystem paths belong in 'Resume Training State'.

async_upload.label: Async upload
async_upload.info: Upload to Hugging Face asynchronously to avoid blocking training.

metadata_author.label: Metadata author
metadata_author.info: Optional author name stored in metadata.

metadata_license.label: Metadata license
metadata_license.info: Optional license string stored in metadata.

metadata_tags.label: Metadata tags
metadata_tags.info: Optional comma-separated tags stored in metadata.
metadata_tags.placeholder: (optional) tags for model metadata, separated by comma

metadata_title.label: Metadata title
metadata_title.info: Optional title stored in the model metadata.
metadata_title.placeholder: (optional) title for model metadata (default is output_name)

metadata_reso.label: Metadata Resolution
metadata_reso.placeholder: (optional) resolution for model metadata, e.g., 1024,1024 or 720,1280

metadata_arch.label: Metadata Architecture
metadata_arch.placeholder: (optional) custom architecture string for model metadata

mixed_precision.label: Mixed precision
mixed_precision.info: Use mixed precision for training. bf16 is generally recommended for FLUX/Z-Image on supported GPUs; fp16 may be less stable.

num_processes.label: Number of processes
num_processes.info: The total number of processes to be launched in parallel.

num_machines.label: Number of machines
num_machines.info: The total number of machines used in this training.

num_cpu_threads_per_process.label: Number of CPU threads per core
num_cpu_threads_per_process.info: CPU threads per process used by accelerate (data loading and preprocessing).

dynamo_backend.label: Dynamo backend
dynamo_backend.info: Backend for torch dynamo JIT. Use 'no' to disable (recommended for stability), or 'inductor' for PyTorch 2.x optimizations.

dynamo_mode.label: Dynamo mode
dynamo_mode.info: Choose a mode to optimize your training with dynamo. Leave empty for default.

dynamo_use_fullgraph.label: Dynamo use fullgraph
dynamo_use_fullgraph.info: Whether to use full graph mode for dynamo or it is ok to break model into several subgraphs

dynamo_use_dynamic.label: Dynamo use dynamic
dynamo_use_dynamic.info: Whether to enable dynamic shape tracing.

multi_gpu.label: Multi GPU
multi_gpu.info: Whether or not this should launch a distributed GPU training.

gpu_ids.label: GPU IDs
gpu_ids.info: Comma-separated GPU IDs to use on this machine (e.g., 0,1). Leave empty for auto.

main_process_port.label: Main process port
main_process_port.info: Port of the main process for multi-GPU runs (0 = accelerate's default 29500).

extra_accelerate_launch_args.label: Extra accelerate launch arguments
extra_accelerate_launch_args.info: List of extra parameters to pass to accelerate launch

training_mode.label: Training Mode
training_mode.info: LoRA trains a small adapter (ltx2_train_network.py). Full Fine-Tuning updates every transformer weight (ltx2_train.py: BF16, fused Adafactor, block swap) and needs 64 GB+ system RAM.

ltx2_checkpoint.label: LTX-2 Checkpoint Path
ltx2_checkpoint.info: Single-file LTX-2 / LTX-2.3 checkpoint. Pre-quantized FP8 and INT8 ConvRot checkpoints are supported.
ltx2_checkpoint.placeholder: Path to ltx-2.3-22b-dev.safetensors (also provides VAE / audio VAE / vocoder)

gemma_root.label: Gemma 3 12B HF Directory (alternative)
gemma_root.info: HuggingFace-format Gemma folder. Required for gemma_load_in_8bit / 4bit. Leave empty when using the single file.

gemma_safetensors.label: Gemma 3 12B Single File (safetensors)
gemma_safetensors.info: Single-file Gemma text encoder (weights + tokenizer + config). Leave empty when using the HF folder.

ltx_version.label: LTX Version
ltx_version.info: 2.3 = LTX-2.3 22B checkpoint, 2.0 = LTX-2 19B checkpoint. Must match the checkpoint file.

ltx_version_check_mode.label: Version Check Mode
ltx_version_check_mode.info: How to react when checkpoint metadata does not match the selected LTX version.

ltx2_mode.label: Training Modality
ltx2_mode.info: video = video-only, av = joint audio+video, audio = audio-only. Caching and training must use the same mode.

vae_dtype.label: VAE Data Type
vae_dtype.info: Data type for VAE latent caching and sampling.

gemma_load_in_8bit.label: Gemma 8-bit (bitsandbytes)
gemma_load_in_8bit.info: Load Gemma in 8-bit to save VRAM during text encoder caching/sampling. Requires the HF directory.

gemma_load_in_4bit.label: Gemma 4-bit (bitsandbytes)
gemma_load_in_4bit.info: Load Gemma in 4-bit NF4. Requires the HF directory.

cpu_staged_checkpoint_loading.label: CPU-staged checkpoint loading
cpu_staged_checkpoint_loading.info: Compatibility mode: load checkpoint tensors on CPU first. Slower, but works around CUDA safetensors loading errors.

flash_attn.label: FlashAttention 2
flash_attn.info: Requires flash-attn built for your CUDA/PyTorch.

split_attn_target.label: Split Attention Target
split_attn_target.info: Split attention modules to reduce VRAM. 'none' disables splitting.

split_attn_mode.label: Split Attention Mode
split_attn_mode.info: Split by batch dimension or query length.

split_attn_chunk_size.label: Split Attention Chunk Size
split_attn_chunk_size.info: Chunk size for query-based splitting (0 = default 1024).

fp8_base.label: FP8 Base
fp8_base.info: Keep base model weights in FP8.

fp8_scaled.label: FP8 Scaled
fp8_scaled.info: Quantize checkpoint weights to scaled FP8 at load time. Use together with FP8 Base.

fp8_keep_blocks.label: FP8 Keep Blocks
fp8_keep_blocks.info: Optional comma list/ranges of transformer blocks kept in bf16 with FP8 Scaled.

fp8_w8a8.label: W8A8 Activations
fp8_w8a8.info: With FP8 Base+Scaled: also quantize activations (int8 W8A8).

int8_convrot_dynamic.label: INT8 ConvRot (quantize at load)
int8_convrot_dynamic.info: Quantize a standard bf16/fp16 checkpoint to INT8 ConvRot while loading. Higher fidelity than FP8 at similar VRAM.

int8_convrot_base.label: INT8 ConvRot (pre-quantized checkpoint)
int8_convrot_base.info: Load a checkpoint already converted with ltx2_quantize_int8_convrot.py (Comfy-compatible).

int8_convrot_groupsize.label: ConvRot Group Size
int8_convrot_groupsize.info: Hadamard rotation group size. 'auto' picks the largest divisor of each layer (256, 64, 16).

int8_convrot_no_mse_clip.label: Disable MSE clip
int8_convrot_no_mse_clip.info: Use plain absmax row scales instead of MSE-optimal clipping (faster load, slightly lower quality).

int8_convrot_write_quality_report.label: Write quality report
int8_convrot_write_quality_report.info: Write per-layer INT8 ConvRot reconstruction metrics JSON into the output folder.

nf4_base.label: NF4 Base
nf4_base.info: NF4 4-bit base quantization (~10 GB weights). Lowest VRAM, lowest fidelity.

quantize_device.label: Quantize Device
quantize_device.info: Device for startup quantization. Empty = backend default (cuda). 'cpu' lowers GPU load-time peaks at the cost of RAM/time.

w8a8_backend.label: INT8 Matmul Backend
w8a8_backend.info: Backend for int8 matmuls (ConvRot / W8A8). Empty = auto (torch._int_mm when available).

blocks_to_swap.label: Blocks to Swap
blocks_to_swap.info: Offload N transformer blocks to CPU RAM (0-47). Higher = less VRAM, slower steps, more system RAM.

use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap.label: Pinned memory for block swap
use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap.info: Faster block transfers when host RAM permits. Disable if you hit block-swap crashes.

block_swap_h2d_only.label: H2D-only block swap
block_swap_h2d_only.info: Stream frozen LoRA base blocks Host-to-Device only. Requires block swap > 0 and gradient checkpointing.

block_swap_ring_size.label: H2D ring size
block_swap_ring_size.info: H2D-only GPU ring buffers. 2 = double buffering (default), 1 = lowest VRAM.

gradient_checkpointing.label: Gradient Checkpointing
gradient_checkpointing.info: Recompute activations during backward to save VRAM.

gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offload.label: Checkpointing CPU offload
gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offload.info: Offload checkpointed activations to CPU (more RAM, less VRAM).

blockwise_checkpointing.label: Blockwise checkpointing
blockwise_checkpointing.info: Checkpoint transformer blocks individually. Lowest peak VRAM, heavy CPU traffic.

ltx2_low_ram_load.label: Low main-RAM loading
ltx2_low_ram_load.info: Write each weight straight to its final device so the checkpoint is never staged whole in main RAM.

full_bf16.label: Full BF16 Weights
full_bf16.info: Train BF16 weights (required to fit 22B on one GPU).

fused_backward_pass.label: Fused Backward Pass
fused_backward_pass.info: Step Adafactor inside backward: no full gradient copy.

ltx2_block_swap_trainable_ring.label: Trainable Block-Swap Ring
ltx2_block_swap_trainable_ring.info: Fastest block swap for full fine-tuning (needs Blocks to Swap > 0).

mem_eff_save.label: Memory-Efficient Saving
mem_eff_save.info: Stream checkpoint writes to keep save-time RAM low.

save_merged_checkpoint.label: Save Merged Bundle At Every Checkpoint
save_merged_checkpoint.info: Every saved checkpoint is already a full bundle (more RAM and disk at save time). Replaces the merge step.

ltx2_fft_merge_after_training.label: Merge Into Inference Bundle After Training
ltx2_fft_merge_after_training.info: Runs ltx2_merge_fft_to_model.py on the final checkpoint: <output_name>_ltx2_bundle.safetensors (~43 GB).

dataset_config_mode.label: Dataset Configuration Mode
dataset_config_mode.info: Generate a dataset TOML from a parent folder of subfolders, or supply your own TOML.

dataset_config.label: Dataset Config TOML
dataset_config.info: The dataset TOML used by caching and training.
dataset_config.placeholder: Path to dataset config .toml (auto-filled when generated)

parent_folder_path.label: Parent Folder Path
parent_folder_path.info: Each subfolder becomes a dataset. Prefix with repeats like '3_name'. Captions are .txt files next to the media.

generated_toml_path.label: Generated TOML Path
generated_toml_path.info: Last generated dataset TOML (reused on Start Training when present).

dataset_resolution_width.label: Resolution Width
dataset_resolution_width.info: Training width (32 px steps for LTX-2). Default 768.

dataset_resolution_height.label: Resolution Height
dataset_resolution_height.info: Training height (32 px steps for LTX-2). Default 512.

dataset_batch_size.label: Dataset Batch Size
dataset_batch_size.info: Per-bucket batch size used during training.

dataset_enable_bucket.label: Enable Bucketing
dataset_enable_bucket.info: Group media into resolution buckets (recommended for mixed sizes).

dataset_bucket_no_upscale.label: Bucket No Upscale
dataset_bucket_no_upscale.info: Never upscale when bucketing (only downscale to fit).

dataset_cache_directory.label: Cache Directory Name
dataset_cache_directory.info: Relative name creates a cache folder inside each dataset subfolder.

caption_strategy.label: Caption Strategy
caption_strategy.info: Content for auto-created captions: the folder name (minus repeat prefix) or empty.

create_missing_captions.label: Create Missing Captions
create_missing_captions.info: Create caption files for media without one.

dataset_num_frames.label: Target Frames
dataset_num_frames.info: Frames per training sample. Rounded down to 8k+1 automatically.

dataset_frame_extraction.label: Frame Extraction
dataset_frame_extraction.info: How segments are pulled from each video: head = first N frames, chunk = consecutive chunks, slide = sliding window, uniform = evenly spaced samples, full = whole video.

dataset_max_frames.label: Max Frames
dataset_max_frames.info: Upper bound on frames used from each video (default 129).

dataset_source_fps.label: Source FPS Override
dataset_source_fps.info: 0 = auto-detect from each video. Set only for variable-frame-rate videos with wrong detection.

dataset_target_fps.label: Target FPS
dataset_target_fps.info: Videos are resampled to this rate during caching (LTX-2 default 25).

ltx2_audio_source.label: Audio Source (caching)
ltx2_audio_source.info: For av/audio modes: take audio from the video container or from external .wav files next to the videos.

separate_audio_buckets.label: Separate audio buckets
separate_audio_buckets.info: Keep audio/non-audio items in separate batches. Effectively required for mixed AV datasets with batch size > 1.

ltx2_first_frame_conditioning_p.label: First-frame conditioning probability
ltx2_first_frame_conditioning_p.info: Probability of keeping frame 0 clean (I2V-style conditioning). 0.1 default; 0.0 = pure T2V.

cache_latents.label: Cache Latents
cache_latents.info: Run VAE latent caching before training.

caching_latent_device.label: Latent Device
caching_latent_device.info: Device for VAE encoding (first GPU from gpu_ids is used for 'cuda').

caching_latent_keep_cache.label: Keep Cache
caching_latent_keep_cache.info: Keep cache files for removed/changed media.

caching_latent_atomic_writes.label: Atomic Writes
caching_latent_atomic_writes.info: Write caches to a temp file first, then replace. Safer on crashes.

caching_latent_vae_spatial_tile_size.label: VAE Spatial Tile (px)
caching_latent_vae_spatial_tile_size.info: 0 = no spatial tiling. Otherwise >= 64 and divisible by 32; reduces caching VRAM.

caching_latent_vae_temporal_tile_size.label: VAE Temporal Tile (frames)
caching_latent_vae_temporal_tile_size.info: 0 = no temporal tiling. Otherwise >= 16 and divisible by 8.

cache_text_encoder_outputs.label: Cache Text Encoder Outputs
cache_text_encoder_outputs.info: Run Gemma text-embedding caching before training.

caching_teo_low_vram.label: Low-VRAM Text Caching
caching_teo_low_vram.info: Moves Gemma's embedding table, the projection and the connector to the GPU one at a time: 5.3 GB instead of 10.8 GB, a little slower, same embeddings. Needed on 12 GB and smaller GPUs.

cache_before_connector.label: Cache pre-connector features
cache_before_connector.info: Also save pre-connector text features (needed for connector LoRA training).

network_module.label: Network Module
network_module.info: Fixed to networks.lora_ltx2 for LTX-2 LoRA training.

network_dim.label: Network Dimension (Rank)
network_dim.info: LoRA rank. 32 is the LTX-2 doc default; 128 for maximum-capacity character/style training.

network_alpha.label: Network Alpha
network_alpha.info: LoRA alpha (fractions allowed; 0 = rank). Common practice: alpha = rank.

network_args.label: Network Args
network_args.info: Extra network arguments passed to networks.lora_ltx2.

network_weights.label: Network Weights (warm start)
network_weights.placeholder: Optional path to existing LoRA weights to continue training from

base_weights.label: Base Weights (merge before training)
base_weights.placeholder: Optional LoRA weights merged into the base before training

dim_from_weights.label: Dim from weights
dim_from_weights.info: Determine rank from the loaded network weights.

scale_weight_norms.label: Scale Weight Norms
scale_weight_norms.info: 0 = disabled. Scales weights when their norm exceeds this value.

lora_target_preset.label: LoRA Target Preset
lora_target_preset.info: Which modules receive LoRA. t2v = video attention+FFN (standard); audio presets for audio training; full = everything.

train_connectors.label: Train text connectors
train_connectors.info: Add LoRA on the Gemma embeddings connector. Requires 'Cache pre-connector features' during TE caching.

no_convert_to_comfy.label: Skip ComfyUI export
no_convert_to_comfy.info: By default both musubi (.safetensors) and ComfyUI (.comfy.safetensors) LoRA files are saved. Check to save only the musubi format.

no_save_original_lora.label: Keep only ComfyUI file
no_save_original_lora.info: Delete the original after ComfyUI conversion. WARNING: resume requires the original format.

discrete_flow_shift.label: Discrete Flow Shift

dynamo_mode.info: Choose a mode to optimize your training with dynamo. Leave empty for default.
